learning_outcomes.text: Understand the methods and tools implemented for Computer-Aided Manufacturing and production on numerically controlled machines.
Understand the challenges associated with additive manufacturing processes and high-speed numerically controlled machining.
Implement Design For Manufacturing approaches for machining and Additive Manufacturing.

syllabus_topics: Introduction to Machining and manufacturing using numerically controlled means
bibliography: CADAM Theory and Practice, I. Zeid, Mc Graw-Hill
Surface Modeling for CadCam, BK. Choi, Elsevier
Fundamentals of Computer Integrated Manufacturing, A.L. Foston, CL Smith, T. Au, Prentice Hall
NC Machine Programming and Software Design, CH Chang, MA Melkanoff, Prentice Hall
degree: Diplôme d'ingénieur Centrale Nantes, spécialité Mécanique (apprentissage)
